text.insert: The background core enqueues completed worker evidence from closeWorkerState and admits other source classes at their explicit sync boundary. Enqueueing uses a stable source identity so repeated close or recovery paths do not create duplicate logical work.

Claiming atomically selects eligible queued or waiting work, moves it to processing, and attaches a fenced lease with an expiry. Completion and failure updates must present the current lease. Retryable failures increment attempt state and move to waiting until backoff expires; exhausted or nonretryable attempts become failed. A crashed processor can be reclaimed after expiry without accepting its partial result.
